job_function: collateral management / margin operations analyst (UMR scope determination)
control_point: AANA is computed and documented each compliance period to determine UMR in-scope status.

citations.source_name: BCBS-IOSCO, Margin requirements for non-centrally cleared derivatives (BCBS d499, April 2020)
12 CFR Part 237 (Regulation KK, FRB, OCC, FDIC margin rules)

consequence_anchor.public_source: BCBS-IOSCO UMR phase-in, Regulation KK and EMIR margin RTS: supervisory powers to impose penalties for failure to compute, document or notify AANA/UMR scope correctly
consequence_anchor.magnitude_band: qualitative: enforcement notices describe penalties tied to materiality and duration; no fixed public tariff

commonality_rationale: Every derivatives-dealing entity crossing the UMR AANA threshold must compute and document its aggregate notional amount each compliance period; the phase-in thresholds and AANA methodology are published by BCBS-IOSCO and transposed in the EU and US regimes.
